verdicts.decision_note: The client sets a 1.5 cm seam allowance for a rolled-hem production-file geometry, with the preceding message establishing its incorporation into the digital artwork.
The client changes the finished pareo dimensions to 130 x 170 cm and the corresponding production artwork dimensions to 133 x 173 cm including seam allowance.
This is the first target-specific implementation claim after the resize request: the freelancer reports placing artwork rescaled to 133 x 173 cm in the Drive folder.
